svg.title: Aliasing: two continuous signals, one sample sequence
svg.desc: Mathematically plotted thirty-kilohertz and eighteen-kilohertz cosines sampled at forty-eight kilohertz from zero to two hundred fifty microseconds. All thirteen sample dots coincide.
svg.text: Aliasing: two continuous signals, one sample sequence
48 kHz sampling: a 30 kHz cosine and an 18 kHz cosine give the same sample values.
cos(2π × 30,000 × n/48,000) = cos(2π × 18,000 × n/48,000), for every integer n.
Samples alone cannot decide which input produced them. Filter unwanted input bandwidth
before sampling. The 24 kHz Nyquist boundary is not a practical filter’s entire passband.
